segments.en: Hello.
Hello Raja ji.
Khushi ji, how are you?
Nice name you have kept.
The name is wonderful.
Hmm.
Are you happy after hearing the name, Khushi ji?
Yes, yes, why wouldn't I be happy?
I am very happy.
Oh, you are happy.
And I am happy to hear your name and your voice.
What do you do, Khushi ji?
Right now, I just do housework.
Housewife.
Housewife, are you married? When did it happen?
Yes, that's why I became a wife.
You became a wife, a house wife. You are a house wife, not your husband's wife.
I am a house wife, oh, I am a house wife.
Why do people get married if not for the house?
Hmm.
So, how many children do you have?
Just one, he is still small.
Okay, how many years have you been married?
It has been three years since I got married.
Okay.
Where does your husband live?
He lives with me, he is at the office right now.
He is at the office.
Do you know how to use the app, the Friends app?
No, no, no, how can you say that? Why are you asking such things?
Is the account yours or his? Whose account is it?
I have linked my sister's account.
Oh, you linked your sister's account. So the money goes to her?
It goes to her, and she withdraws it and gives it to me via ATM.
Whenever I need it, when it becomes a large amount, she withdraws it and gives it to me all at once.
That's true.
It's not much, just 100-200 rupees, it happens.
You are not very active, are you?
Yes, that's true, I have a lot of work at home.
There is a girl, I talked to her for an hour the other day.
Oh.
She stays online from 7 AM to 12 AM.
Oh my god, really? She must be a girl, not married.
No, she is unmarried.
Yes, that's why I am saying she is not married.
She is very good, but she doesn't pick up calls, she gives them to others.
Oh, she must be busy.
Always busy.
But she talks very well, whatever you talk about, it's good.
Huh?
Whatever you talk to her about, it's all wonderful.
Okay, okay, yes, yes, she is open-minded, that's why.
Open.
Hmm.
That's right. No, I don't have time, I don't have time to come online.
People ask me when I will come online, when I will talk again, but I can't tell them.
I don't have any time.
Whenever I get time.
